title: Generating Diverse Q&A Benchmarks for RAG Evaluation with DataMorgana

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the LLM's inherent tendency to generate monotonous, long, and sophisticated questions by measuring the lexical, syntactic (Part-of-Speech templates), and semantic diversity of generated Q&A benchmarks using metrics like N-Gram Diversity (NDG), Self-Repetition Score (SRS), Compress Ratio (CR), and Homogenization Score (HS).
